title: Bernadette Roberts at Loveland OH retreat, May 2006
description: Photograph captioned 'Bernadette Roberts at Loveland OH retreat, May 2006', embedded in the TAT Forum (August 2006 issue) report on her retreat; the article also cites the May 2006 retreat brochure. Photographer uncredited (a TAT Foundation attendee); copyright TAT Foundation / photographer, no open licence stated. The only dated, captioned retreat photograph of her found online.

title: Bernadette Roberts portrait on SpiritualTeachers.org profile (reused by IMERE)
description: Headshot on the profile 'Bernadette Roberts: A Christian Mystic for Our Time' (and companion Bodian-interview page). The Institute for Mystical Experience Research and Education (imere.org) reproduces the same photograph with the credit 'photo: www.spiritualteachers.org', confirming the image exists there. Original photographer and licence unknown; treat as all-rights-reserved.

title: Bernadette Roberts author photo on Goodreads author page
description: Goodreads author profile (13 books, 31 followers) shows a small author image; search snippets confirm an image slot but not its content. Probably the same widely circulated headshot. Licence unknown.

title: Bernadette Roberts contributor page, Open Road Media
description: Open Road Integrated Media (ebook publisher of What Is Self? for Sentient Publications) contributor page with bio; Open Road contributor pages normally carry an author photo but the search index shows only text. Unverified.

title: CCE-Bernadette-Roberts.png — event graphic, 'The Astounding Bernadette Roberts' workshop (Holy Family Passionist Retreat Center, 19 Feb 2022)
description: Promotional image file 'CCE-Bernadette-Roberts.png' on the event page for Fr. Michael K. Holleran's day workshop 'The Astounding Bernadette Roberts: Insights & Experiences of a Modern Christian Mystic' (also listed by Contemplative Outreach). Likely a flyer graphic incorporating her portrait and/or book cover. Copyright Holy Family Retreat Center.

title: The Experience of No-Self: A Contemplative Journey — Shambhala first edition cover (1982)
description: Third-party scan of the 1982 Shambhala first edition including cover. Shambhala reprinted it in 1984 (ISBN 0394726936 / 9780394726939 Random House distribution, and 0877732892 / 9780877732891); 1984 cover shown on AbeBooks and Amazon listings. Cover designer not identified. Book text copyright Bernadette Roberts; Shambhala cover art rights.

title: The Experience of No-Self — SUNY Press revised edition cover (1993)
description: Publisher catalogue page for the revised edition (SUNY Press, March 1993, 212-213 pp., ISBN 0791416941 / 9780791416945). Cover image on SUNY page, Amazon, Goodreads (345092) and Google Books (id TNiurgHbID4C). SUNY Press contributor page lists Roberts without a photo.

title: The Path to No-Self: Life at the Center — Shambhala first edition cover (1985)
description: Internet Archive lending-library scan of the Shambhala 1985 edition (ISBN 0877733066 / 9780877733065; Random House-distributed variant 0394729994 / 9780394729992; 214 pp.) with cover. First-edition cover photographed in eBay listing 165048954853; also on Amazon, AbeBooks, ThriftBooks and a second archive.org upload (roberts.path-to-no-self).

title: The Path to No-Self: Life at the Center — SUNY Press edition cover (1991)
description: SUNY Press 1991 reissue (ISBN 0791411419 hb / 0791411427 pb, 214 pp., new introduction; Roberts's preface thanks Bill Eastman of SUNY Press). Cover image on Open Library, Goodreads (6266081) and Google Books (id 04ry5d6qtNYC).

title: What Is Self? — Mary Botsford Goens first/second edition cover (1989)
place: Austin, Texas / Marina Del Rey, California, USA
description: Self-published 1989 edition (publisher given variously as Mary Botsford Goens, Austin TX, or Mary Goens Publishing, Marina Del Rey CA; some listings call it '2nd edition'). Internet Archive lending scan includes the cover; used-copy photos on AbeBooks/Alibris. Cover designer unknown.

title: What Is Self? A Study of the Spiritual Journey in Terms of Consciousness — Sentient Publications cover (2005)
description: Sentient Publications 2005 trade paperback (ISBN 9781591810261, 208-256 pp. per listing). Cover design credited to Nick Cummings, book design Timm Bryson (front matter, archive.org scan roberts.what-is-self). Cover shown on Simon & Schuster distributor page, Strand, AbeBooks, ThriftBooks, Theosophical Society review.

title: What Is Self? — Sentient / Open Road Integrated Media ebook cover
description: Ebook edition (ISBN 9781591812258, Sentient+ORM / Open Road Integrated Media, 258 pp.) cover shown on Everand, ebooks.com, OverDrive and Google Books (id BH08EAAAQBAJ). Same Nick Cummings artwork as the print edition.

title: The Real Christ — ContemplativeChristians.com cover (2017)
description: Self-published via ContemplativeChristians.com, Feb 2017, 524 pp., ISBN 9780692851159. Cover image: an engraving from an old Catholic Encyclopedia volume that Roberts copied, enlarged and coloured because it reminded her of the Trinity (centre evokes a monstrance); cover design Brian Burrowes (front matter). Full scan with cover on archive.org (roberts.real-christ); cover also on Books-A-Million, ThriftBooks, Christianbook, Google Books (edxeAQAACAAJ).

title: Contemplative: Autobiography of the Early Years — cover (2018)
description: Posthumous autobiography published by ContemplativeChristians.com, 2018, ISBN 9780692125175, c.306-316 pp. The archive.org scan carries an 'About the Cover' note (cover likely uses a photograph of the young Roberts; the note sits beside the headings 'The Monk', 'Age 17', 'Happiest Day in my Life'). Cover on AbeBooks, Amazon, Books-A-Million, Tertulia, Google Books (BBRntwEACAAJ) and the Bernadette Roberts blog books page.

title: Jenseits von Ego und Selbst: Erfahrungsbericht einer spirituellen Reise — German edition cover (Arbor, 1993)
description: German translation of The Experience of No-Self, Arbor Verlag, Freiamt 1993, ISBN 3924195277, translated by Franz Loschnigg and Karin Hein. Cover image on Eurobuch / ZVAB listings. Cover artist unknown. The only non-English edition found.

title: Self-published works and manuscripts listed on the Bernadette Roberts blog ('Other Writings' page)
description: The friends' blog (set up at Roberts's request; successor to bernadettesfriends.blogspot.com) has a 'Books' page and an 'Other Writings / self-published works' page that display covers of her self-published booklets and manuscripts. Titles and cover images not enumerated by search; needs direct inspection.

title: A Passage Through Self / The Essence of Christian Mysticism — DVD set packaging (recorded retreat)
description: The only authorised video of Roberts: her annual retreat 'The Essence of Christian Mysticism' (nine hours in 4 files plus handouts) and the 'circles' talk 'A Passage Through Self', recorded (reviewer says original recordings date to 1994) and sold as a DVD/CD set via the friends' blog. Page shows DVD packaging and sample stills. The blog states that no authorised recordings exist on YouTube. In Sept 2021 the Aquarian Catholic Spiritual Community announced the recorded retreat talks could be viewed free.

title: YouTube playlist 'Bernadette Roberts' — retreat-talk video stills
description: Playlist surfaced alongside the 2021 'talks available at no cost' announcement; probably hosts the recorded retreat talks (video of Roberts speaking, usable for stills). Authorisation status unclear — the friends' blog disclaims all YouTube uploads.

title: 'Bernadette Roberts on why Christ is not in Christianity' — YouTube video of Roberts speaking (still)
description: Video excerpt of Roberts speaking (apparently from the recorded retreat); linked as 'Full Video' by the Dancing Paradox podcast episode 'Bernadette Roberts | The Path To No Self' (Alex Hickman), which uses a frame as its thumbnail. Unauthorised per the friends' blog; copyright the recording's owners.

title: 'No Self ~ Bernadette Roberts ~ Christian Mystics' — YouTube video thumbnail/stills
description: Third-party YouTube video on Roberts (likely readings over images of her); thumbnail may reuse the spiritualteachers.org portrait. Also: Shawn Ellison's 'Beyond Unitive Consciousness: The Path to No Self with Bernadette Roberts' (Qoqfir9czOY) and Susanne Marie's commentary video (xO7KKKaxBwo). Unauthorised / fan uploads.

title: Carmel of Saint Teresa, Alhambra, California — the Discalced Carmelite monastery Roberts entered in January 1949
place: 215 E Alhambra Rd, Alhambra, California, USA
description: Around Alhambra (Dec 2022) feature 'Only in Alhambra: The Cloistered Discalced Carmelite Nuns of the Monastery of Saint Teresa' with photographs of the 1922 monastery building and community (founded 1913); further photos on cloisteredlife.com directory and the monastery site carmelteresa.org. Roberts entered at 17 and stayed c. 8.5-9 years. No Wikimedia Commons file found. Photos copyright Around Alhambra / the Carmel.

title: New Camaldoli Hermitage, Big Sur — site of Roberts's annual extended retreats for forty years
description: Wikipedia article (with Commons-hosted photographs, free licences) on the Camaldolese hermitage (Immaculate Heart Hermitage) in the Santa Lucia Mountains where Roberts made retreats annually for the last forty years of her life, and where (per one account) the deepening of the no-self experience occurred. Additional photos: Flickr 'View from New Camaldoli Hermitage, Big Sur' by Heather Polley, 1 Jan 2020 (licence to check); Angelus News feature by Heather King.

title: Stephan Bodian interview, Yoga Journal Nov/Dec 1986 — magazine layout / photo (scan)
description: Written interview (Roberts answered questions in writing) printed in Yoga Journal Nov/Dec 1986 and reprinted in Bodian's Timeless Visions, Healing Voices (1991). Text reproduced on realization.org, spiritualteachers.org, awakeningtoreality.com; the original magazine spread (and any photo) would be in Google Books' Yoga Journal archive. Not yet located.

title: Bernadette Roberts — Wikipedia / Wikidata entry (no infobox image found)
description: Wikipedia article (Wikidata Q4892809: Therese Bernadette Roberts, 20 May 1931 - 27 Nov 2017, Laguna Beach). Searches found no Wikimedia Commons file for her (all Commons 'Bernadette' hits are Bernadette Soubirous) and no infobox image is reported by mirrors (Wikiwand, en-academic). Recorded as a negative result; any freely licensed portrait would have to be sourced elsewhere.
